versions.changelog: Server 0.3.2: attachments fixed in the console, Codex CLI can write the drafts.
Desktop console as an installable Windows app on the human side; server 0.3.1, same 24 tools; setup notes on sharing the data directory.
Minimum server version raised to 0.2.4: approval toasts and Telegram approve/reject buttons for tool requests only work from that version.
中文简介大幅扩充：完整的安装配置步骤、批准流程（Windows Hello 带外批准）和 0.2 自动回复规则说明，全部中文。供代理阅读的英文操作指引保持不变。/ Expanded Chinese intro with full setup steps; agent-facing instructions unchanged.
Chinese intro for ClawHub browsers (README and desktop console are already available in Chinese); agent-facing instructions stay in English to save tokens.
Reply rules (semi/auto) behind OS verification; approve/reject/edit from Telegram or the Windows toast; documents what the agent cannot do with rules. Requires gigamail >= 0.2.1.
GIGAMAIL_ROOT, approval gated by Windows Hello / Touch ID (gigamail >= 0.1.4), Telegram notification via GIGAMAIL_APPROVAL_NOTIFY_CMD, dedup/rate-limit documented
First release: setup, approval gate, untrusted-content rules
